task: Two additions to this dotfiles repo's pi extensions, both specified by FAILING test files you must make green WITHOUT editing them. Read the test files first - their header comments are the contract and explain why each rule exists. (1) Add a `date` claim class to .pi/agent/extensions/epistemic-guard.ts. Today its ClaimClass union is version|url|cve|perf|flag|syspath, so a fabricated date sails through: the agent wrote `tested 2026-08-10` into a doc from a user message that contained no date at all. Extend ClaimClass with "date", add extraction for ISO and worded forms, normalise worded keys, make ISO and worded forms of the same month cross-match for provenance, skip bookkeeping (changelog headings, `date:` field lines, ISO timestamps) and fenced blocks, and add a VERIFY_HINT entry routing dates to the session stores (memledger / ledger / session_search) because that is where a date about the user's own history lives. Reuse the existing corpus/provenance/hedge/footer plumbing - do not build a parallel path. Spec: .pi/agent/tests/loop-date-class.test.ts. (2) Implement .pi/agent/extensions/entity-qualifier-nudge.ts, currently a stub. It nudges when a device identifier (eth0, enp2s0f0np0, br0, nvme0n1, sda1, switch ports like eth0/1/1) is cited as EVIDENCE - incident/evidential vocabulary nearby - with no host qualifier naming which box it belongs to. Critically, a DATE is not a qualifier: `eth0 flapped on 2026-08-08` must still fire, because that exact sentence shipped a wrong argument built from a real fact about a different interface. Export needsHostQualifier and NUDGE_LINE, and wire a message_end hook that appends NUDGE_LINE once per session to assistant messages, skipping when ctx.hasUI is false, with kill switch PI_ENTITY_NUDGE_OFF=1 and a session_shutdown cleanup - mirror the structure of .pi/agent/extensions/lookup-before-ask.ts, which solves the same shape of problem. Spec: .pi/agent/tests/loop-entity-qualifier.test.ts.
rules: Do NOT edit anything under .pi/agent/tests/ - the test files are the contract. Make them pass as written.
NEVER move, edit, restore or delete .pi/harness.json or any .pi/harness-* file. They are loop machinery and the judge has been told to ignore them.
.pi/agent/settings.json was already modified in the working tree before this task began. Do not touch it, unstage it, or try to remove it from any diff.
No new dependencies. node/bun stdlib only.

Match existing extension style in this repo: two-space indentation, double quotes, a JSDoc header explaining WHY the thing exists, and section comments. Read epistemic-guard.ts and lookup-before-ask.ts before writing.
Do not run git commit, git reset, git stash, git checkout, git update-index, or any other git ref/index mutation.

A check satisfied by a stub is a FAILED iteration: no `throw new Error("not implemented")`, no empty function bodies, no hard-coded test answers, no returning a canned value for a specific input string.

The date class must go THROUGH the existing pipeline: extractClaims segments, pushUnique (so hedgedNear and dedupe apply for free), Corpus, hasProvenance. A special-case branch that bypasses them is wrong even if the tests pass.

Cross-matching ISO and worded dates is a provenance-time concern, not an extraction-time one: do not rewrite a worded claim's key into ISO, or the block message stops quoting what the model actually wrote.
If you need a paragraph-long comment to justify why a workaround is OK, the code is wrong - fix the code.

sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --spec 'Two pi-extension changes in a dotfiles repo. (1) epistemic-guard.ts gains a date claim class: ISO and worded dates become claims, worded keys are normalised (lowercased, commas stripped, early/mid/late qualifier dropped), ISO and worded forms of the same month cross-match during the provenance check, changelog headings / `date:` field lines / ISO timestamps / fenced code yield nothing, and VERIFY_HINT routes dates to the session stores. It must reuse the existing extraction segments, pushUnique, Corpus and hasProvenance rather than a parallel code path, and must not disturb the existing version/url/cve/perf/flag/syspath behaviour or the derived-perf marking added earlier. (2) entity-qualifier-nudge.ts is implemented from a stub: needsHostQualifier is true when a device identifier is cited with evidential/incident vocabulary and no host qualifier, where a date explicitly does NOT qualify; the extension appends NUDGE_LINE once per session on message_end, skips when ctx.hasUI is false, honours PI_ENTITY_NUDGE_OFF=1 and cleans up on session_shutdown. REJECT if: a test-specific string is special-cased, the date class bypasses the shared pipeline, worded keys are rewritten to ISO at extraction time, the nudge can fire more than once per session or in headless runs, or the JSDoc headers do not explain why the rule exists.
